observation.command: cd /workspace; ps aux | grep -E 'serve.mjs|nx serve|ng serve' | grep -v grep | head; echo "---endpoints---"; for h in app cms boards; do code=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --resolve "$h.urbo.localhost:80:127.0.0.1" "http://$h.urbo.localhost/" 2>&1); echo "$h -> $code"; done
